name: EPIC 211329249
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 5, 6.0 solar radii and 1.05 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 2,941 parsecs away, 6 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 5, give 1.05 solar masses and 6.0 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,805 K at its surface.
